purpose: Repair confirmed CSS cascade, geometry and interaction defects without replacing the room identity.
fixes: Isolated header link and label classes from legacy picture-card yellow-circle styling.
Restored dark-on-yellow practical-step symbols in dark mode by removing a conflicting color priority.
Fitted desktop room geometry to available height and width; retained aligned door/artwork coordinates and compact short-screen treatment.
Kept destination cards parallel at normal laptop reading widths; preserved narrow-screen stacked rows.
Restored non-home destination emblems on tablet and phone layouts.
Made explicit Resume views start even while its control retains focus or hover; later interaction still pauses.
Restored intended Arabic body size and line height.
Corrected print selectors for the new wrapper and removed decorative arrival actions/coverage from printed guides.
preservation: All existing place data, sources, translations, country data and artwork unchanged.
Guide, arrival and console text and links retained in 24 representative localized routes.
Eleven unrelated pending map files excluded from the release.
limits: Existing explicit browser URL policy block prevents rendered visual verification; no alternate renderer or screenshot workaround used.
Geometry cases use CSS arithmetic and representative header measurements, not actual browser layout.
publication: Ahmed GitHub Pages preview only; Hamza production untouched; preview submissions disabled.
